observed_value: cost_currency values GBP/EUR on flagged rows 367908-367910
anchor_value: source schedule amortized cost/fair value columns are USD-denominated; visible foreign unit, where present, belongs to par amount/units

findings.detail: Flagged cost_currency values GBP/EUR are not supported by the source amortized cost cells; the 123Dentist rows show C$ only in the par amount/units column.
2080 Media amortized cost row has no foreign currency marker, so EUR cost_currency is unsupported by the source row.

rationale: FX03 is a real data error because the raw schedule does not support non-USD cost currencies for the flagged holdings. The 123Dentist rows show C$ in the par amount/units position while amortized cost and fair value are separate valuation columns; the 2080 Media row shows numeric par, amortized cost, and fair value with no EUR marker. The stored GBP/EUR cost_currency values therefore reflect a localized extraction/column mapping defect, not a valid non-USD cost disclosure.
